title: Shopify webhooks silently stop arriving after the endpoint was slow or down for a few hours
symptoms: webhookSubscriptions no longer lists a topic your app created at install
Warning emails to the emergency developer address about failing deliveries
Orders processed twice when a slow handler finished after Shopify retried
cause: Shopify treats no answer within five seconds as a failure, retries 8 times over 4 hours, and then deletes subscriptions created through the Admin API. Retries also mean the same event can arrive twice.
fix: Acknowledge with 200 right away and process from a queue, dedupe on X-Shopify-Webhook-Id, and run a reconciliation job. Prefer shopify.app.toml subscriptions, which Shopify does not delete on failure.
affected: Shop-specific webhook subscriptions created with the Admin API, all versions
